rationale: The strict all-units rule was found, using timing and geography only, to collapse otherwise estimable multi-region structure because of one or two isolated series. This refinement preserves estimable regional replication while excluding unsupported units only from the shared-forcing coupling estimand.

selection_rule.regional_level_rule: Choose the finest APBP or CCAMLR level where qualifying groups jointly contain at least 95% of that species' frozen bridged units and there are at least two qualifying groups.
selection_rule.fallback: If neither regional level qualifies, use species-wide forcing only if the species-wide group satisfies the frozen forcing-group support criteria.
selection_rule.unsupported_units: Retain unsupported units in secondary long-run growth/trend analyses but exclude them from the lambda shared-forcing coupling estimand.

justification_for_0_95: Uses the same 95% completeness tolerance already adopted in the outcome-blind atlas gates; demographic count magnitudes, trends and site-trait associations remain unopened.
terminal_boundary: Do not change 0.95 after count magnitudes are opened.
Do not lower the minimum of two qualifying regional groups after count magnitudes are opened.
Do not move unsupported units back into lambda estimation by post-outcome pooling.
No new geographic partition may be introduced after demographic outcomes are opened.
